name: Cu/Au Ratio Momentum vs SPY Forward Returns
description: Tests whether the copper/gold ratio's momentum predicts S&P 500 returns. Computes the 63-day ROC of the HG/GC ratio, ranks it into quartiles using a 504-day rolling percentile rank (Q1=most falling, Q4=most rising), and measures SPY forward 3-month returns by quartile. Key question: does extreme rising Cu/Au (Q4) give meaningfully better SPY returns than extreme falling (Q1)?
source:
# Cu/Au Ratio Momentum vs SPY Forward Returns
# Signal: 63-day ROC of copper/gold ratio, ranked into quartiles (504-day rolling percentile)
# Target: SPY forward 3-month returns by quartile

# --- Data ---
spy = market_data_source()()
spy_close = spy.c

# Copper (HG) continuous futures — NoAdjustment for ratio levels
hg_raw = reference_futures(ticker='HG')()
hg = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(hg_raw.o, hg_raw.h, hg_raw.l, hg_raw.c, hg_raw.v, hg_raw.oi, hg_raw.s)

# Gold (GC) continuous futures — NoAdjustment for ratio levels
gc_raw = reference_futures(ticker='GC')()
gc = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(gc_raw.o, gc_raw.h, gc_raw.l, gc_raw.c, gc_raw.v, gc_raw.oi, gc_raw.s)

# --- Cu/Au Ratio & Momentum ---
# ffill reference data to handle calendar misalignment
hg_close = ffill(hg.c)
gc_close = ffill(gc.c)

# Cu/Au ratio (copper price / gold price)
cu_au_ratio = hg_close / gc_close

# 63-day rate of change of the ratio
roc_63 = roc(period=63)(cu_au_ratio)

# Rolling percentile rank over 504 days (2 years) — 0 to 100 scale
pctrank = percentrank(period=504)(roc_63.result)

# --- Quartile Assignment ---
# Q1 = most falling (0-25), Q2 (25-50), Q3 (50-75), Q4 = most rising (75-100)
quartile_label = conditional_select(
    is_valid(pctrank.result) and pctrank.result <= 25, "Q1 (Falling)",
    is_valid(pctrank.result) and pctrank.result <= 50, "Q2",
    is_valid(pctrank.result) and pctrank.result <= 75, "Q3",
    is_valid(pctrank.result) and pctrank.result <= 100, "Q4 (Rising)",
    "N/A"
)

# Numeric quartile for ordering (1-4)
quartile_num = conditional_select(
    is_valid(pctrank.result) and pctrank.result <= 25, 1.0,
    is_valid(pctrank.result) and pctrank.result <= 50, 2.0,
    is_valid(pctrank.result) and pctrank.result <= 75, 3.0,
    is_valid(pctrank.result) and pctrank.result <= 100, 4.0,
    0.0
)

# --- SPY Forward 3-Month Returns ---
spy_fwd_3m = forward_returns(period=63)(spy_close)

# Filter to valid quartile observations only (exclude warmup period)
fwd_ret_valid = where(is_valid(pctrank.result) and quartile_num > 0, spy_fwd_3m.result)

# --- Win Rate (% positive forward returns) per quartile ---
# Dense 1/0 series for correct Mean-based hit rate calculation
win_flag = 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_ret_valid) and fwd_ret_valid > 0) else 0.0
# Only count bars with valid forward returns AND valid quartile
win_flag_filtered = where(is_valid(fwd_ret_valid), win_flag)

# --- Per-quartile filtered series for summary table ---
fwd_q1 = where(is_valid(pctrank.result) and quartile_num == 1.0, spy_fwd_3m.result)
fwd_q2 = where(is_valid(pctrank.result) and quartile_num == 2.0, spy_fwd_3m.result)
fwd_q3 = where(is_valid(pctrank.result) and quartile_num == 3.0, spy_fwd_3m.result)
fwd_q4 = where(is_valid(pctrank.result) and quartile_num == 4.0, spy_fwd_3m.result)

win_q1 = where(is_valid(fwd_q1), 1.0 if fwd_q1 > 0 else 0.0)
win_q2 = where(is_valid(fwd_q2), 1.0 if fwd_q2 > 0 else 0.0)
win_q3 = where(is_valid(fwd_q3), 1.0 if fwd_q3 > 0 else 0.0)
win_q4 = where(is_valid(fwd_q4), 1.0 if fwd_q4 > 0 else 0.0)

# --- Reporters ---

# Chart 1: Boxplot — distribution of SPY fwd 3M returns by Cu/Au ROC quartile
boxplot(
    mode=BoxplotMode.grouped,
    title='Does Cu/Au Momentum Predict SPY Returns?',
    x_axis_label='Cu/Au 63d ROC Quartile',
    y_axis_label='SPY Forward 3M Return',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    median_color=Color.Black,
    show_outliers=True,
    category='Cu/Au Signal',
    order=0
)(label=quartile_label, values=fwd_ret_valid)

# Chart 2: Median return per quartile — the punchline bar chart
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.labeled,
    agg=AggregationType.Median,
    title='Median SPY 3M Return by Cu/Au Momentum Quartile',
    x_axis_label='Quartile',
    y_axis_label='Median Forward 3M Return',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    category='Cu/Au Signal',
    order=1,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ])
)(values=fwd_ret_valid, label=quartile_label)

# Chart 3: Hit rate per quartile — what % of the time is the forward return positive?
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.labeled,
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    title='How Often Are SPY 3M Returns Positive?',
    x_axis_label='Quartile',
    y_axis_label='Hit Rate (% Positive)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=False,
    category='Cu/Au Signal',
    order=2,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.5, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='50%')
    ])
)(values=win_flag_filtered, label=quartile_label)

# Summary table: N, Median, Hit Rate, Best, Worst per quartile
# Using standard mode with explicit per-quartile series to avoid grouping misalignment
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='SPY Forward 3M Return Stats by Cu/Au ROC Quartile',
        col_headers=['Q1 (Falling)', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4 (Rising)'],
        row_headers=['Obs Count', 'Median Return', 'Hit Rate', 'Best', 'Worst'],
        row_size=5,
        col_size=4,
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    category='Cu/Au Signal',
    order=3
)(fwd_q1, fwd_q2, fwd_q3, fwd_q4, fwd_q1, fwd_q2, fwd_q3, fwd_q4, win_q1, win_q2, win_q3, win_q4, fwd_q1, fwd_q2, fwd_q3, fwd_q4, fwd_q1, fwd_q2, fwd_q3, fwd_q4)
